description: Lightweight progress check for an in-progress compliance scan. Returns current status (pending/crawling/scanning/completed/failed) and how many modules have finished (20 Standard or up to 33 with Pro/Agency tier including Hosting-Standort (Schrems II) (Art. 13 lit. f DSGVO), Widerrufsbutton (§356a BGB), KI-Transparenz (Art. 50 KI-VO), Tech-Stack-Aktualität (Art. 32 DSGVO), Anwaltsspezifische Prüfung (BORA / BRAO), Maklerspezifische Prüfung (§34c GewO + MaBV + GEG), Arztspezifische Prüfung (BOÄ + HWG + Art. 9 DSGVO), Finanzvermittler-Prüfung (§34d/f/h/i GewO + FinVermV), Gastronomie-Prüfung (LMIV + PAngV + IfSG), Kosmetik-Prüfung (KosmetikV + HWG + UWG), Bau-/Sanierung-Prüfung (§34c GewO + HwO + MiLoG), Hotel-/Beherbergung-Prüfung (BMG + PAngV + GEG + DSGVO)). Use this to poll progress. When status is 'completed', call get-scan-result for the full report.
